invariant:
fact ack: bool
fact queued: bool
fact settled: bool
check (!settled || ack) && (queued || settled)

next.ack:
fact ack: bool
fact known: bool
fact queued: bool
fact reply: bool
fact settled: bool
check ack || (known && reply)
next.queued:
fact ack: bool
fact known: bool
fact queued: bool
fact reply: bool
fact settled: bool
check queued && !(known && reply)
next.settled:
fact ack: bool
fact known: bool
fact queued: bool
fact reply: bool
fact settled: bool
check settled || (known && reply)
